patterns.note: The hero section utilizes a split-screen layout, featuring a large lifestyle image on the left and a multi-step interactive form on the right, designed for immediate user engagement.
Content sections frequently employ a grid of consistently styled cards (e.g., product cards, testimonial cards) with subtle shadows and ample internal padding.
Prominent, bold sans-serif headings introduce each major content section, establishing a clear visual hierarchy and guiding the user through the page.
A cool, muted blue palette dominates the hero and background elements, providing a sense of calm and trustworthiness, contrasted with crisp white surfaces and dark text.
Upon scrolling, a compact promotional banner and the main navigation bar (logo and search icon) become sticky at the top of the viewport, ensuring persistent brand presence and access to key actions.

technique_notes: The hero section is constructed with a two-column layout where the left side displays a full-height background image with overlaid text, while the right side hosts a multi-step form to capture user input immediately.

Scrolling down the page triggers a transformation where a slim, full-width promotional banner and the primary navigation elements (logo and search) transition from their initial position to a fixed, sticky header at the top of the screen.

Content is organized into distinct, full-width sections, often featuring a responsive grid of uniformly styled cards that present information or products with a clean, minimal aesthetic and subtle visual separation.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body text) provide strong visual anchors, complemented by clear, readable body text and smaller, often uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (buttons, input fields, and content cards feature a slight, consistent border-radius).
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and a consistent, moderate padding within content blocks and cards, creating an airy yet structured feel.

standout: The site's distinctive feature is its immediate and direct engagement through a multi-step form integrated directly into the hero section, making it highly conversion-focused. This, combined with a clean, medical-yet-approachable aesthetic, effectively addresses a sensitive topic with clarity and trust.
